text:
ashley: Quick architecture check-in: thinking of moving from single render service to sharded renderers by tenancy/size. Motivation: noisy tenants cause tail latencies for others.

kevin: Sharded makes sense. Question: how do we keep RBAC consistent across shards?

maria: We can centralize auth decisions at ingress and propagate a signed perm-hash to the shard. That avoids duplicate auth calls.

chao: Signed perm-hash helps but needs short TTL. If shard caches perms, invalidation becomes tricky on role change.

ashley: Invalidation options: a) time-based TTL (30s) b) invalidation bus when role changes c) versioned perm-hash so new hashes supersede old. Thoughts?

kevin: Versioned perm-hash + short TTL seems pragmatic. Invalidation bus is reliable but adds infra.

maria: Agree on versioned perm-hash. Also require shards to check central auth on miss and backoff to avoid thundering herd.

chao: Another angle: classify widgets by sensitivity. Low-sensitivity (metrics) can be post-filtered on shard, high-sensitivity must be pre-authorized. This reduces auth volume.

ashley: We'll add widget metadata: sensitivity: {low, medium, high}. Product needs to annotate.

kevin: Cache keys need to include perm-version + tenant + view-id. Otherwise cache poisoning across role changes.

maria: Also include shard-id in telemetry to detect skew.

ashley: Routing rules proposal: route_by: {tenant_hash mod N} for heavy tenants, and size-based routing for mixed dashboards (small widgets -> lightweight pool).

chao: For mixed dashboards, maybe aggregate small widgets into a single tile request to reduce overhead. Frontend can batch nearby widgets.

kevin: API idea: /render/batch accepts list of descriptors; renderer can choose to stream individual widgets or a single composed payload.

ashley: Good. We'll define two shapes: streaming-chunks and composite-blob. Frontend picks preference but backend can override for SLOs.

maria: Observability: emit metric render_path.{stream,composite}.{p50,p95,p99}, auth_calls_per_render, cache_hit, perm_miss. Dashboards for per-tenant p95.

chao: Alarms: if p95 across any shard > 400ms or auth_error_rate > 0.5% trigger paging.

security: Note: perm-hash must be HMAC with key rotation. Don't log unhashed perms. Also ensure we never include user_id in cache keys.

ashley: Agreed. Key rotation policy: rotate keys monthly, shards must accept last N keys for verification.

kevin: Performance note: precompile templates and store compiled artifacts in a shared object store accessible to shards to reduce cold starts. Warm a top-k on deploy.

maria: We'll prototype an in-process LRU for perm-hash with capacity 10k entries and TTL 30s, plus async refresh on near-expiry.

chao: For canary: run 10% tenants on sharded model with synthetic dashboards and diff against monolith renders. Capture layout and data mismatches.

deploy-bot: feature-flag "sharded-render-v1" created at 1762528000 targeting 10% tenants.

sre-bot: synthetic-canary job started at 1762528050, running 500 synthetic dashboards across both render paths.

ashley: Action items: (1) kevin: draft RFC for API shapes + routing rules; (2) maria: perm-cache prototype + perf numbers; (3) chao: batching shim for frontend; (4) sre: canary harness + alerts. We'll review RFC next Tue.

kevin: I'll aim for RFC by EOD Fri.

maria: I'll drop initial perf numbers in the doc this week.

ashley: Thanks all, closing thread until RFC lands.
